# Math.NET Numerics {#sec-appendix-mathnet-numerics}

[Math.NET Numerics](https://numerics.mathdotnet.com){target="_blank"} is the C# package used throughout this guide for vector and matrix computations. This appendix collects two short reference programs demonstrating the parts of the library needed for the FE program: basic vector operations and solving a linear system.

Add the package to a project as described in @sec-design-and-implementation, or directly:

```bash
dotnet add package MathNet.Numerics
```

Using the aliases

```xml
<Using Include="MathNet.Numerics.LinearAlgebra.Matrix&lt;double&gt;" Alias="Matrix" />
<Using Include="MathNet.Numerics.LinearAlgebra.Vector&lt;double&gt;" Alias="Vector" />
```

lets you write `Matrix` and `Vector` instead of the full generic type names.

## Vectors

`Vector` objects are created via the `Vector.Build` factory, support the usual arithmetic operators, and provide methods such as `Norm` and the outer product.

## Matrices and linear systems

`Matrix` objects are created the same way as vectors. `Matrix.Solve` solves a linear system $\mathbf{A} \mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ for $\mathbf{x}$, which is exactly what is needed to compute displacements from the assembled stiffness matrix and load vector.

```{.csharp include="oofem-csharp/numerics-02/Program.cs"}
```
